text:
An AI agent reportedly picked a gene therapy from 19 candidates, chose a brain target, and controlled the injection in a mouse epilepsy experiment. “Let’s test that idea” is starting to sound a lot more literal.

And don’t worry—the craniotomy was still done by a human, and a vet approved every irreversible step. It’s hard to say when agents might handle the whole procedure, but that day could be closer than we think.
